projects.name: [Backup - DQ Conference - Workshop] Team building
projects.opportunity_statement:
Situation

  • A manager has budget available for an annual team event

  • Several event formats are being considered:

    • Team dinner

    • Outdoor activity

    • Overnight retreat

  • Employee participation and satisfaction are uncertain.

  • The manager can choose an event immediately or gather additional information before committing.

Possible actions

  • Select an event immediately

  • Survey employees before deciding

  • Run a small pilot activity

  • Choose an event based on the information collected

objectives.name: Gather every body!
objectives.description: It is important that most of people join the event. The participation rate will be seen as a success criteria.

objectives.name: Have fun
objectives.description: The chosen activity should be fun for most or all employees

objectives.name: Know each other better
objectives.description: The aim of the event is that employees know each other better and work later better as a team.

objectives.name: Always safe!
objectives.description: Whatever chosen activity, eployees need to come back home safe!
